name: cleancopy
description: Cleans up text copied from the terminal so it pastes neatly into other apps.

scripts.build:helper: swift build -c release --package-path helper && mkdir -p helper/bin && cp helper/.build/release/cleancopy-helper helper/bin/
scripts.build:helper:universal: swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 --package-path helper && mkdir -p helper/bin && cp helper/.build/apple/Products/Release/cleancopy-helper helper/bin/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:helper:universal && npm test
